privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy and Personal Data Processing Agreement
privacyPage.p1: This Privacy Policy (hereinafter 'Policy') is developed in accordance with the Law of the Republic of Uzbekistan No. ZRU-547 'On Personal Data' dated July 2, 2019, and other applicable laws, establishing the procedures for collection, systematization, storage, processing, and protection of users' personal data on the 'Zehin' platform. By registering or using the Platform, the User voluntarily consents to these terms. Administration: self-employed individual under the 'Birlik' brand (TIN: 200836354). Official contact: Telegram — https://t.me/zehinuz?direct.
privacyPage.p2: The Administration collects only the minimum amount of data required to render services. During the use of the Platform, the following data is processed:
p2List: Registration data: name (as provided by the User), mobile phone number and account password;
Account password: for security purposes the password is stored only in encrypted (hashed) form and is never disclosed to anyone in plain form;
Optional profile data: the subject (specialisation) taught, current pedagogical category, gender, date of birth and an avatar chosen from a preset collection;
Learning activity: history of completed tests, statistics of incorrect answers, points earned (XP), streaks and rating indicators;

Payment data: the selected plan, payment date, amount and status. Please note: bank card numbers and other payment details are not stored on the Platform — they are processed solely within the relevant payment system;
Referral programme data: the number and names of users who registered through the invitation link;
Technical data: standard server records (logs) of IP address, device and browser type — solely for the purposes of ensuring security, detecting errors and protecting against abuse;
Browser storage (localStorage/cookies): the login session, selected language, theme (dark/light mode) and similar technical settings are stored on the User's own device.
privacyPage.p3: Personal data is processed exclusively for the following specified and lawful purposes:
p3List: To identify the User, confirm account login by phone number and password, and prevent unauthorised access;
To personalise the learning process: generating tests, review schedules and statistics matched to the selected subject and level of preparation;
To process the Pro Subscription, record payments and give notice of subscription status;
To ensure the referral programme works correctly and to calculate discounts and bonuses;
To reflect the User's activity in the public rating (Leaderboard);
To analyse Platform stability, fix errors and improve service quality (on the basis of aggregated, anonymised statistics).
privacyPage.p4: The Administration does not sell, rent, or trade personal data to third parties for commercial purposes. Minimal data required for service provision may be transferred only to trusted technology partners (processors):
p4List: Google Firebase (Google LLC) — the cloud infrastructure providing authentication, database and hosting; data is stored in encrypted form on protected servers;
Google Analytics — to collect anonymised statistics on use of the Platform (page views, overall activity);
Payment systems (Click and the other methods shown on the Platform) — to the minimum extent necessary to process payments;
State authorities — only on the official and lawful request of a court or an authorised body, in the manner established by the legislation of the Republic of Uzbekistan.
privacyPage.p5: In the public Leaderboard section of the Platform, only your name, selected avatar, and learning scores (points, level) are visible to other users — your phone number and contact details are never disclosed. The name of a user registered via your referral link may be visible to you, and your name may be visible to the user who invited you.
privacyPage.h6: 6. Data Retention Period and Right to Erasure
privacyPage.p6a: Personal data is retained for as long as your account remains active. The User has the right to modify their data or request total account deletion at any time via the
privacyPage.p6b: section on the Platform or by submitting a request through the
privacyPage.p6c: without logging in. Upon account deletion, profile data and statistics are immediately erased, and backup data is permanently destroyed within 30 calendar days. Payment transaction logs may be retained as required by financial auditing regulations.
privacyPage.p7: Data is transmitted via HTTPS (TLS) encrypted protocols between device and server, database access is strictly governed by Firebase Security Rules, passwords are stored using secure hash functions, and login attempts are rate-limited. Users are required to safeguard access to their phone number and device, and never share their account password with anyone — including individuals identifying as Administration staff. The Administration will never ask for your password.
privacyPage.p8: In accordance with Law ZRU-547, Users have the following rights:
p8List: Obtain information about what data concerning them is being processed;
Demand the correction and updating of inaccurate or outdated data;
Withdraw consent to the processing of their personal data and demand deletion of the account;
Apply to the Administration or to an authorised state body if they consider their rights to have been violated.
privacyPage.p9: The Administration reserves the right to amend this Policy due to legal updates or service enhancements. New revisions become effective upon publication on the Platform, indicated by the 'Effective Date' at the top of the page. Continued use of the Platform after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.

termsPage.title: Terms of Service and Public Offer
termsPage.h1: 1. Legal Status of Agreement and Parties
termsPage.p1: This document constitutes an official public offer in accordance with Articles 367, 369, and 370 of the Civil Code of the Republic of Uzbekistan. Registering, using, or making payments on the 'Zehin' platform (hereinafter 'Platform') signifies full understanding and unconditional acceptance (acceptance) of these terms by the individual (hereinafter 'User'), holding equal legal force to a signed paper agreement. The Platform is designed for self-preparation of pedagogical staff for qualification exams. Services are provided by an registered self-employed individual under the 'Birlik' brand (hereinafter 'Administration'). Official contact channel: Telegram — https://t.me/zehinuz?direct.
termsPage.p2: Access to the Platform is based on phone number and password authentication. The User agrees to:
p2List: To give only their own phone number at registration — the account is bound to that number, and its holder is responsible for all actions performed on the account;
Not to give the account password to third parties (including colleagues and close relatives);
To use one account personally only — shared use of an account by several persons or devices at the same time is prohibited;
To notify the Administration immediately if the phone number passes to another person or unauthorised access to the account is suspected.
termsPage.p3: Within the framework of fair use of the Platform, Users are strictly prohibited from:
p3List: Deliberately providing false information about oneself at registration and in the profile;
Mass-copying the question base with bots, scripts or scraper/parser software, mounting hacking attacks on the system, or attempting to exploit vulnerabilities;

Distributing Platform materials (questions, explanations, screenshots/screencasts) in paid or public groups, on social networks or other resources without the written permission of the Administration;
Using offensive language in the Leaderboard system or in communication with the support service, or damaging the reputation of other users or of the Administration;
Abusing the referral programme and promo codes by opening fake accounts.
termsPage.h4: 4. Scope of Services: Free Mode, Trial Period, and Pro Subscription
termsPage.p4: Platform services are offered under the following modes:
p4List: Free trial period (Trial): a newly registered User may be granted full access for a limited period to explore the Platform's capabilities; the exact duration and conditions are stated on the Platform;
Free mode: once the trial period ends, the User continues to use the core features free of charge within daily limits;

Pro Subscription: opens full access to all topics, the exam simulator, smart review and detailed statistics for the selected period (for example, 1, 3 or 12 months). The subscription takes effect from the moment payment is confirmed and remains valid until the end of the specified period. If a new payment is made on top of an active subscription, the remaining days are not lost — they are added to the term;
The subscription does not renew automatically: no funds are debited automatically when the term ends — the User pays again at their own discretion, otherwise the account returns to free mode;
Prices: the current plans and prices are shown in the Platform's «Pro» section. The Administration has the right to change prices, but a change does not affect a period already paid for.
termsPage.p5: Payments are conducted in Uzbek Som (UZS) via the payment methods indicated on the Platform:
p5List: Payment methods: through the official Telegram operator (https://t.me/zehinuz?direct), and also through the payment systems connected to the Platform (Click and others — the methods currently available are shown in the application's payment window);

Activation: once payment is confirmed, the Pro Subscription is attached to the User's profile. Payment through the operator may take a short time to activate (usually from a few minutes to a few hours);

Refund policy: because Zehin is a digital educational service, once the subscription is activated the service is deemed to have been rendered and the amount paid is not refunded. Exception: cases where payment was accepted but the service did not activate at all because of a technical fault — in that case the Administration will resolve the problem or refund the amount in full. In such a case please get in touch via https://t.me/zehinuz?direct.
termsPage.p6: Referral invitation programs and promotional codes may be active on the Platform. Specific terms regarding discounts, bonus days, and rewards are published in corresponding sections. The Administration reserves the right to modify terms or cancel rewards in case of fraudulent activity or abuse. Referral bonuses are non-redeemable for cash.
termsPage.p7: All materials on the Platform — question database, explanations, methodological notes, software code, UI design, and branding elements — are intellectual property of the 'Zehin' project and protected by copyright laws. Materials may only be used for personal preparation. Unauthorized distribution or copying will result in account termination without refund and legal prosecution.
termsPage.p8: The Platform is an independent educational preparatory tool and is not an official government agency or official exam provider. Questions are independently authored learning materials. The Administration does not guarantee passing government qualification exams solely through platform usage — final results depend on individual preparation and effort.
termsPage.p9: Disputes between parties shall first be resolved through good-faith negotiation via https://t.me/zehinuz?direct. If unresolved, disputes will be submitted to jurisdiction under Uzbek law. Continued use of the Platform after updates constitutes agreement to updated terms.

analysis.methodNote: Readiness is calculated from your results in each section. A section with few answers is pulled toward your own average — so 100% out of 3 questions will not mark a whole section as mastered. The large number is your expected exam score; actual knowledge is calculated with the random-guessing share removed.
